tables.name: propChapter
tables.merge: Merge by alias and numeric ID; reject differing meanings; never replace an entire product workbook.

integration: Use UnityCLI excel schema/query to inspect the target workbook; merge only the listed entries with dry-run before writes.
Run the target project e2cs export workflow to regenerate Config.Excel aliases, table classes and JSON/bytes. Do not copy development generated classes.
For localized text, regenerate and load CommonText and Language tables before opening the UI.
Check every code alias resolves and required tables load; this package is a reference, not an installed runtime.

dependencies.name: propLevel
dependencies.reason: CHAPTER_HOME.Levels contains example 10001. Master only consumes the chapter alias; a product that uses Levels must supply its own level data.
